limitations_and_boundaries: The paper does not report results for all possible splits; ablation results for other splits are in supplementary.
The method is evaluated only on three datasets (RPE1, K562, Norman).
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

research_questions.statement: How can we accurately predict transcriptional responses to multiplexed genetic perturbations, including unseen conditions?

provenance.text_excerpt: Particularly, AttentionPert has exceptional capability in the most challenging out-of-distribution (OOD) task: predicting the effects of novel multi-gene perturbations where none of the perturbed genes have been encountered during the training phase.

claims.statement: AttentionPert has exceptional capability in the most challenging out-of-distribution task: predicting effects of novel multi-gene perturbations where none of the perturbed genes have been encountered during training.

provenance.text_excerpt: The ablation study conclusively demonstrates that each component of AttentionPert contributes to its overall performance.

claims.statement: Each component of AttentionPert (PertWeight, PertLocal, Gene2Vec initialization, nonadditive bias) contributes to its overall performance.

provenance.text_excerpt: AttentionPert outperforms prior methods including the SOTA GEARS model on RPE1 and K562 datasets (Replogle et al. 2022), each of which comprises >1000 single-gene perturbations, and on the Norman dataset containing 131 two-gene perturbations (Norman et al. 2019).

claims.statement: AttentionPert outperforms prior methods including the SOTA GEARS model on RPE1 and K562 datasets and on the Norman dataset.

evidence_spans.content: AttentionPert integrates global and local effects in a multi-scale model, representing both the nonuniform system-wide impact of the genetic perturbation and the localized disturbance in a network of gene–gene similarities.

methods.name: AttentionPert
methods.protocol_description: Multi-level deep-learning method integrating multi-head attention with graph neural networks on augmented gene interactions and pre-trained co-expressive gene representations (Gene2Vec). Consists of PertWeight encoder for nonuniform global effects and PertLocal encoder for localized effects with nonadditive bias. Predicts expression shift added to control expression.

methods.protocol_description: State-of-the-art method for genetic perturbation prediction using Gene Ontology similarity knowledge graph.
